dos.text: Set badged="true" as the literal string, not just an empty boolean attribute, since render() checks getAttribute("badged") == "true" verbatim to decide whether to build the badge-stack fragment.

Expect a toolbarbutton placed inside an unopened <panel> to stay unrendered until the panel first opens, connectedCallback deliberately skips render() until the panel gets its hasbeenopened attribute, which the shared popupshowing listener sets.

donts.text: Don't add arbitrary child elements to a non-badged toolbarbutton before it first renders, render() only tolerates observes/template/menupopup/panel/tooltip/box children and returns early on anything else, leaving the icon and label fragment never created.
